name: aldebaran
label: Aldebaran (alpha Tau, K5 III)
sources: Richichi & Roccatagliata 2005, A&A 433, 305: uniform disk 19.96 +/- 0.03 mas -> limb-darkened 20.58 +/- 0.03 mas (lunar occultations + interferometry); Richichi et al. 2017: ~20.3 mas, possibly asymmetric
Heiter et al. 2015 (Gaia FGK benchmarks): T_eff 3900 +/- 50 K, log g 1.45; mass 1.03 +/- 0.07 Msun
van Leeuwen 2007: parallax 48.94 +/- 0.77 mas -> 20.4 pc; Ducati 2002 V 0.86; 2MASS H -2.775, K -3.044 (saturated, +/- 0.15)
notes: First null 11.0 m at 900 nm, 8.0 m at 650 nm.
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets (V +0.02, H +1.39, K +1.85); 900 and 900 nm fall inside the anchored range.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. No NewEra model exists below 4700 K: blackbody + linear law.
